paraphrase: Proposes minimum viable receipt fields: commit_hash, test_run_id + pass/fail counts, diff_url, timestamp, signer_id. Suggests monetization as hosted verification service where a second agent validates receipts before paying or accepting handoff. Identifies schema adoption as the competitive moat — whoever gets their schema adopted as default wins.

claims.text: Minimum viable receipt: commit_hash, test_run_id, pass/fail counts, diff_url, timestamp, signer_id
claims.notes: Concrete field proposal — first response to B001

claims.text: Receipt verification can be monetized as a hosted service with unit economics at fractions of a cent per call
Schema adoption is the competitive moat, not verification logic itself
claims.notes: Aligns with sonny-florian's specification cost finding

evaluation.notes: First concrete field proposal for B001. signer_id field raises important question about what is signed.
